title: dwg2dxf Unicode argv, startup linkage, and filesystem path fast slice

scope: Use UTF-8 filesystem paths for dwg2dxf input preflight and output existence checks.
On Windows, accept wide process arguments and strictly encode them as UTF-8 before entering the shared CLI parser.
Exercise Unicode input and output paths in the FreeCAD CLI compatibility control on every host.

implementation_notes: The Windows wmain bridge rejects invalid UTF-16 instead of substituting characters.
MinGW links with -municode so its console CRT selects wmain; MSVC uses its native wmain startup selection.

The manually dispatched native FreeCAD workflow now builds the source generator and includes both build-tree and installed CLI compatibility tests, in addition to its tracked-file FreeCAD handoff control.

The tracked FreeCAD open/insert CTests set INPUT_PATH_UNICODE=ON, copy the pinned DWG under 'entrée café input with spaces', and exercise the actual FreeCAD-to-installed-converter subprocess path; this native workflow is configured but not yet executed for the current revision.
The CLI preflight now uses std::filesystem::u8path for both input and output.
The test source is generated at an ASCII path, then cmake -E copy stages the same bytes at a Unicode path; generated files remain in the build scratch directory.

includes: isolated installed converter with clean loader environment and Unicode input/output conversion
